versionPairs.description: A compiled, code-split Bun app (Bun 1.3.14, `bun build --compile --splitting --format esm --minify`, unpacked with bun-decompile): Claude Code's layout from 2.1.242 — an entry that imports `/$bunfs/root/<chunk>.js` siblings, units and palette static, the other four modules through import(), sharing a helper chunk. The input reader links the chunks into one program (exp216) and the run proceeds as for a single-file Bun bundle. Generated by ../bun-apps. v1.1.0 changes the palette (static) and archive (lazy) reports and adds a function to the CommonJS dep.
